faq.q: How much does a villa in Halkidiki cost?
faq.a: Villa prices depend on location, sea view, plot size, build quality and distance to the beach. Sea-view villas in the most sought-after parts of Kassandra and Sithonia are at the top of the market. Filter by price to see current villas, and ask us about the full costs of each.

faq.q: Are there villas with a private pool for sale in Halkidiki?
faq.a: Yes. Many of our villas have a private pool, often with sun terraces and outdoor dining areas. Use the filters to show only villas with a pool, and ask us about pool maintenance if you will be away for long periods.

faq.q: Can buying a villa in Halkidiki qualify for the Greece Golden Visa?
faq.a: It can. As of November 2026, a villa in Halkidiki can qualify if it is one residential property of at least 120 m² bought for €400,000 or more. Other conditions apply, including limits on short-term letting. Our lawyer confirms each case before you commit.

faq.q: Which area of Halkidiki is best for a luxury villa?
faq.a: Kassandra suits buyers who want services, restaurants and a shorter drive from Thessaloniki. Sithonia suits those who want greenery, privacy and quiet coves. Both have sea-view villas, and many buyers view villas on both peninsulas before deciding. We can arrange viewings in both areas in one trip.

body:
Luxury villas with private pool

A private pool, outdoor living areas and a garden that is easy to maintain are what most villa buyers ask for. Check the plot size, the quality of construction and insulation, and who will look after the pool when you are away.

Sea-view and beachfront villas

Sea views are the main driver of villa prices. Beachfront villas are rare, as the shore in Greece is public and building near it is restricted. Hillside villas often have wider views and more privacy.

Villas for sale in Kassandra

Kassandra is the most developed peninsula, with beach clubs, restaurants and services around areas such as Sani and Pefkochori, and the shortest drive from Thessaloniki airport.

Villas for sale in Sithonia

Sithonia is greener and quieter, with pine forests, clear coves and views towards Mount Athos. It suits buyers who value privacy and nature over nightlife.

Villas and the Greece Golden Visa

As of November 2026, to be confirmed by our lawyer, one residential property in Halkidiki of at least 120 m² bought for €400,000 or more may qualify for the Greece Golden Visa. See our Golden Visa page for the conditions.

Buying a luxury villa in Greece: what to check

Before you buy, your lawyer and an engineer check the title, the building permit, any legalisation and outstanding debts. Ask about running costs too: gardening, pool care, security and the annual ENFIA property tax.
